Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers about working with EBP.

What is Elevate Build Partners?

Elevate Build Partners (EBP) connects homeowners, property owners and businesses with trusted local construction professionals for residential and commercial projects.

Where do you work?

We serve homeowners and businesses in Albuquerque, Rio Rancho and surrounding New Mexico communities.

What types of projects do you handle?

Roofing, remodels, additions, new builds and barndominiums, fences and gates, carports, painting, basements, landscaping and more.

How does it work?

Tell us about your project. We review it, match you with prequalified contractors suited to the scope, and the contractors send you proposals to compare.

How are contractors vetted?

Contractors complete a prequalification review before they are matched with projects, and their proposals are reviewed for scope and clarity.

Does it cost anything to submit a request?

Submitting a project request does not obligate you to hire anyone. You only move forward when you choose a proposal you are happy with.

Who sets the project price?

The contractor provides the proposal and pricing for your specific scope. We help you compare proposals side by side.

How long until I hear back?

We aim to respond quickly after reviewing your request. Timing for proposals depends on project size and contractor availability.

Do I need permits?

Many projects need permits in New Mexico. Your contractor will advise what applies to your scope and jurisdiction.

How do I get started?

Use the contact details below or send us a message with your address, project type and timeline, and we will take it from there.
